endpoints.reach: Vincent DiFilippo Nature Preserve to Good Hope Access
endpoints.coordinateEvidenceDetail: cumberland_county_conodoguinet_b5 B5: The current Cumberland County access table identifies B5, Vincent DiFilippo Nature Preserve, as a named concrete Conodoguinet launch and publishes 40.2561, -77.0192. The official table coordinate is retained as the shared launch pin; it is not projected to an NHD centerline.
endpoints.note: Stored coordinate matches the exact named authoritative water-entry control (cumberland_county_conodoguinet_b5 B5) on Conodoguinet Creek; the 206 ft named-flowline offset reflects incomplete or generalized NHD coverage, not a proposed coordinate move.

endpoints.reach: Vincent DiFilippo Nature Preserve to Good Hope Access
endpoints.coordinateEvidenceDetail: pa_pfbc_good_hope_conodoguinet_access OBJECTID 128 / ID_NO 665: The current PFBC-verified fishing and boating access layer identifies Good Hope in Cumberland County on Conodoguinet Creek, owned by PFBC and classified as an access area. Its point geometry (40.2588980574, -76.9763923626) replaces the route's geocoded road-address point. This is an access-area anchor, not a surveyed wet-edge coordinate.
endpoints.note: Stored coordinate matches the named authoritative access-area control (pa_pfbc_good_hope_conodoguinet_access OBJECTID 128 / ID_NO 665) on Conodoguinet Creek; treat the agency parking/carry anchor as on/near-water evidence, but confirm the exact water entry and landing before launch.
